description: Submit a single image to the Transkribus Processing API for text recognition and get back a process ID. Supply exactly one of imageUrl or base64 (JPEG, TIFF or PNG, up to 20 MB).

config.description: How the image should be processed

lineDetection.description: Layout analysis settings. Omit to use the service defaults.

baselineAccuracyThreshold.description: Binarization threshold for the baseline mask, 0-255. Higher is stricter.

maxDistForMerging.description: Maximum distance between two baselines for them to be merged

minimalBaselineLength.description: Detected baselines shorter than this are dropped

modelId.description: Line detection model ID. Ignored when regions and lines are supplied.

numTextRegions.description: Regions to build from detected lines: one -1, few 1.6, medium 1.0, many 0.4

textRegionClusteringType.description: horizontal: all lines horizontal. mixed: lines rotated by 0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees.

htrId.description: ID of the Transkribus HTR model to apply

languageModel.description: Enable the built-in language model when generating the transcription

content.description: Existing regions and lines. When supplied, line detection is skipped.

imageUrl.description: URL of a publicly reachable image file

base64.description: Base64-encoded image data (JPEG, TIFF or PNG, up to 20 MB)

image.description: The image to process: exactly one of imageUrl or base64

name: transkribus_processing_submit_image
title: Submit Image for Processing
